name.en: Taichung Prefectural Hall / Old Taichung City Hall

identity: The historic street-corner government hall at99MinquanRoad, not the modern Xitun CityHall and not neighboring TaichungShiyakusho.

officialPages.evidence: Official conservation description confirms corner entry and two wings,classicalorders,dormers and roundedpediments.

officialPhotos.visualInspection: Direct official front photo inspected in own Chrome tab. Cream-white classical frontage with red-brick panels,slateMansardroof/rounded dormers,two-storycolumns abovegroundarcades,centralprojectingpedimentedentry,twoangledwings and framingpalms. This older image includes a forecourt fountain; it is secondary context, not the required current centerpiece.

distinguishingMotifs: A street-corner central entrance mass with two long two-story wings extending away to left and right.
Dark slate-gray Mansard roof with a broken/steep slope and small rounded dormer/oculus windows.
Cream-white classical columns and cornices set against warm red-brick wall panels.
Projecting central portico/pediment above a deep arched doorway; repeated ground-floor arcade openings and upper columned balcony.
Low formal forecourt and tall slender palms support the civic scale; fountain/flag details are optional context rather than the identity.
materialColors: Deep dark entry/arcade shadows and green planting
pixelPriorities: Keep the corner-entry mass,slateMansardroof and white-column/red-brick contrast first.
Represent classical details with clean ordered clusters; never turn the facade into a fantasy palace.
rights: Reference links only. Source photographs are not copied into shipped game art. Draw original pixel interpretations.
